basic_details.job_title: IIITDM Jabalpur Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: PDPM Indian Institute of Information Technology, Design and Manufacturing, Jabalpur (IIITDM Jabalpur) is inviting applications for 1 Project Assistant post. The post is purely temporary and is on a research project sponsored by the Agri-Hub Foundation, IIT Indore. The pay is Rs. 20,000/- per month (consolidated). The appointment is initially for six months and can be extended up to the project duration based on performance. how_to_apply: Applications are made online only, by filling in the Google Form linked in the notice (see Important Links below). The form must be submitted by 8 November 2026, 23:59 hours. The notice does not describe any other steps or list documents to upload.

For any queries about the position, candidates may contact the Principal Investigator: Dr. Akshay Pandey (PI), CSE Discipline, PDPM- IIITDM Jabalpur, Dumna Airport, Road, Jabalpur, MP- 482005. Phone: 9074525228 (M). Email: [email protected].
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be given to candidates for appearing in the interview and written test. The Institute/PI reserves the right to reject any application without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech. or equivalent in CSE/ECE/SM/ME, Agriculture, or a relevant Science discipline. Preference will be given to GATE-qualified candidates. Desirable: Candidates with hands-on experience in any of the following: IoT sensors and sensor integration Machine learning Image/signal processing Data analysis Fieldwork Agricultural technology For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, candidates should check the official notification. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIITDM Jabalpur Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Applications are made online only, by filling in the Google Form linked in the notice (see Important Links below). The form must be submitted by 8 November 2026, 23:59 hours. The notice does not describe any other steps or list documents to upload. For any queries about the position, candidates may contact the Principal Investigator: Dr. Akshay Pandey (PI), CSE Discipline, PDPM- IIITDM Jabalpur, Dumna Airport, Road, Jabalpur, MP- 482005. Phone: 9074525228 (M). Email: [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is by written test/interview. The written test is only for non-GATE candidates. The written test and interview will be held offline on 10 November 2026 (tentative) at the CSE Discipline, PDPM IIITDM Jabalpur.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be given to candidates for appearing in the interview and written test. The Institute/PI reserves the right to reject any application without assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIITDM Jabalpur Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 (01) Project Assistant post, on the AgriTwinLoop research project sponsored by the Agri-Hub Foundation, IIT Indore.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIITDM Jabalpur Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 8 November 2026, 23:59 hours.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the IIITDM Jabalpur Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech. or equivalent in CSE/ECE/SM/ME, Agriculture, or a relevant Science discipline. Preference will be given to GATE-qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the IIITDM Jabalpur Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 20,000/- per month (consolidated).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIITDM Jabalpur Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Apply online by filling in the Google Form given in the notice, by 8 November 2026, 23:59 hours.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the IIITDM Jabalpur Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Selection is by written test/interview. Both will be held offline on 10 November 2026 (tentative) at the CSE Discipline, PDPM IIITDM Jabalpur.

faq.question: Q7. Do GATE-qualified candidates have to take the written test?
faq.answer: No. The written test is only for non-GATE candidates. GATE-qualified candidates are also given preference.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IIITDM Jabalpur Project Assistant post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely temporary. It is initially for six months and is extendable up to the project duration based on performance.

faq.question: Q9. Can the selected Project Assistant register for a Ph.D. at IIITDM Jabalpur?
faq.answer: Yes. The selected candidates will be eligible to register for the Ph.D. degree at PDPM IIITDM Jabalpur against a subsequent advertisement, as per its eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the written test or interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA will be given to candidates for appearing in the interview and written test.
